fixture: fixtures/shop-app (sample Vue 3.4 + Pinia app with planted issues)

evals.name: product-list-lag
evals.prompt: the products page (src/views/ProductList.vue) in my shop app at {APP} gets really laggy when i type in search or tick 'in stock', we have ~2000 products. what's wrong and how do i fix it?
evals.expected_output: Ranked findings explaining the lag: filtered() called in template, index keys, v-if+v-for, deep watch, plus the storeToRefs bug and leaked resize listener.
assertions: Recommends replacing the filtered() template call with a computed
Flags :key="i" (index key) on the ProductRow list
Flags v-if and v-for on the same ProductRow element
Flags the deep watch on filters (visibleCount should be computed / derived)
Flags destructuring the cart store without storeToRefs as a reactivity bug
Flags the window resize listener that is never removed
Every finding cites a file:line location
Does not modify any fixture files

evals.name: reuse-review
evals.prompt: Can you go through {APP}/src and tell me where we're duplicating code? I'd like to pull shared stuff into composables or shared components before the team adds more views.
evals.expected_output: Reuse findings: fetch/loading/error composable, merge UserCard/AdminCard, use existing useFormat, theme prop drilling.
assertions: Suggests one composable for the duplicated fetch + loading + error logic in ProductList, OrdersView and UsersView
Suggests merging UserCard and AdminCard into one component (props and/or slots)
Points to the existing useFormat composable for the duplicated Intl currency/date formatting
Flags theme being drilled through UserCard/AdminCard -> UserAvatar -> AvatarImage and suggests provide/inject or a store
Every finding cites a file:line location
Does not modify any fixture files

evals.name: full-audit
evals.prompt: we're shipping shop-app ({APP}) next week, do a vue performance + reuse pass over the whole thing and tell me what to fix first
evals.expected_output: Whole-app ranked report with bugs first, bundle and render issues, and at least one reuse item.
assertions: Flags eagerly imported route components and suggests () => import() lazy loading
Flags full lodash and/or moment imports as bundle cost
Flags the Chart.js instance held in a deep ref and suggests shallowRef or markRaw
Flags the setInterval in SalesChart that is never cleared
Ranks correctness bugs (storeToRefs, v-if+v-for, index keys) in the highest-priority section
Includes at least one code-reuse finding
Does not modify any fixture files
